# Key matrix

Each half has a 6 × 7 diode matrix, `col2row`: the diode anode is on the switch/column side and the cathode on the ROW net. Diodes are 1N4148W (SOD-123) on the bottom side next to each hot-swap socket. Both PCBs share **one** matrix netlist: `COLn` is physical column Cn (C0 outer, C6 inner) on both halves.

- Keys per half: **37**, total **74**.
- Slot (R0, C6) is the display on both halves and is not mapped.
- Legends are the ZMK base layer (QMK `ergodox_ez` layer 0; LEFT/RGHT moved to layer 1).

## ZMK transform (6 × 14)

The global map the keymap and ZMK Studio see. Left columns 0–6 are physical C0–C6; right columns 7–13 are physical C6–C0 (the right `.dts` reverses `col-gpios` and sets `col-offset = <7>`).
